brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights released a report titled "Scholasticide and Genocide in Gaza: Assessment, Testimonies and Legal Analysis," examining the systematic destruction of education infrastructure in Gaza. Produced in cooperation with the Centre for Palestine Studies at SOAS University London and Friends of Palestinian Universities, the report characterizes the destruction as scholasticide—the deliberate targeting of educational systems—and frames it as part of a broader genocide against Palestinians.

The report combines assessment of damage to schools and universities with testimonial accounts and legal analysis of the destruction of Gaza's education sector.

title: Palestinian rights group releases report on Gaza education destruction
